info.headline: Cancellation of Severe Thunderstorm Warning for Capricornia, Wide Bay and Burnett and Southeast Coast forecast districts
info.description:
This warning is now cancelled.
Thunderstorms are likely to persist between Moranbah and Gayndah for the next couple of hours but are not expected to be severe. Should severe thunderstorms redevelop, a new warning will be issued as necessary.
3 to 4 cm was observed in the Gin Gin area around 3.15 pm.
info.instruction: Emergency services advise people to: * Never drive, walk, play or ride through floodwater. It is dangerous. * Stay away from storm water drains. * Stay away from fallen powerlines. * Drive slowly and never drive through floodwaters. If the road is flooded or damaged, go another way. * For storm help, call the SES on 132 500 or download the free SES Assistance QLD app.
